bundle.shortDescription: Fix broken laptop keys and silence annoying ones
bundle.longDescription: MACM KeyBridge makes a damaged laptop keyboard usable again: it silences the key you keep held as an electrical bridge, remaps keys that never respond, blocks the airplane-mode key and diagnoses whether the fault is Windows or the keyboard. It also silences keys that get in the way, such as Copilot or the Windows key. 100% local: no network, no telemetry, no accounts.
